title: How Long Would You Last in the Last Ice Age? #shorts
description_hook: You wake up 20,000 years ago, at the coldest point of the last Ice Age, with no coat, no fire and a woolly mammoth for a neighbor.

beats.say: How long would you last in the last Ice Age? You wake up on a planet 6.1 degrees Celsius colder on average. Here, it's worse.
beats.img: a lone human silhouette seen from behind on a windswept frozen tundra under a pale low sun, frost-covered grass and distant white hills, breath-fogging cold, vertical frame

beats.say: The sea is 125 meters lower. You're standing on future seafloor. No coat. No fire.
beats.img: a vast exposed coastal plain stretching toward a far-off grey ocean, dry seabed ridges and scattered boulders, cold overcast light, tiny figure in the center

beats.say: Up north, the ice is about 3 km thick. Right beside you, a woolly mammoth 3.7 meters tall. It doesn't notice you.
beats.img: a towering woolly mammoth with long curved tusks and shaggy brown fur walking across a snowy steppe, a colossal wall of glacier ice glowing blue on the horizon, low angle

beats.say: Then: fresh human footprints in the mud. People live here, next to giant ground sloths and dire wolves. Follow them.
beats.img: a trail of bare human footprints pressed into wet pale mud beside a shallow lake, huge clawed animal tracks crossing them, misty morning light

gumi.say: Gumi's odds: 70 percent. People lived through this. Find them before the wolves do.
